summary: First full E2E run of ENTITLE (Spring Boot + H2 behind FastAPI gateway; React frontend). Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (health, 21 schemes + filters, 404, demo auth cookie, /me, 401s, profile validation, assessment/results/preview, saved schemes, applications CRUD + history + invalid status 400, checklists, notifications read/read-all/dismiss/preferences, guide chat (source=ai, real Claude reply), impact, account delete + demo re-login recreates profile). Frontend: landing, login personas -> dashboard, wizard validation/back/conditional questions/review edit/submit -> results, result cards, schemes search+filters, scheme detail (save, add to tracker, checklist, official link new tab, guide drawer), checklist tick persists + print, applications update/history/delete, notifications, simulator full 8-step flow, Kannada/Hindi switching + notice, impact charts, privacy, profile delete (healthcare) all work. Found several logic/UX bugs below, none blocking.

minor.issue: LLM history = findTop10ByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(userId) across ALL schemes (and shared demo users). Asking about PMJJBY, the AI replied 'Correction: My earlier answers named the wrong schemes (the scholarship and Ayushman Bharat)...' — cross-scheme context bleed. Filter history by schemeId (or reset per drawer session).
findTop40ByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtAsc returns the OLDEST 40 messages, so after 40 messages the newest are never shown. Use Desc + reverse.

Dedupe key 'docs-<scheme>-<remaining>' creates a new notification each time the remaining count changes; old ones ('3 remaining', '2 remaining') stay listed simultaneously. Notifications also persist after the application is deleted. Remove/dismiss superseded keys and orphaned app notifications.

Not a partial update: applicationDate/deadline/referenceNumber are overwritten with null when omitted (verified: PUT {status} wiped referenceNumber+deadline). UI sends full object so UI is fine, but API contract is lossy.
applicationDate and referenceNumber in request body are ignored on create (only status/notes/deadline saved).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Add to application tracker' always calls loginDemo(persona.id), silently replacing the current session — a signed-in Google user running the simulator gets logged out of their own account and into a shared demo persona; it also overwrites that persona's checklist. Warn/confirm or skip re-login when user already signed in.
Unread count only refreshes on route change; after 'Mark read' / 'Mark all read' on /notifications the bell badge stays stale (2 -> still 2; after mark-all still showed 1).

issues: Word spaces visually collapse in headings/FAQ triggers/card titles: 'Youreligibility results', 'IsENTITLEa government website?', 'AtalPension Yojana'. Reduce negative tracking or add word-spacing.
uppercase + tracking-[0.2em] applied to Indic text breaks conjuncts (e.g. 'पात्र ता मूल्यां कन'). Disable letter-spacing for kn/hi.
'Sign in' wraps to two lines, close icon touches edge, scrollWidth 392 > 390 (slight horizontal overflow).
Native date inputs (browser default picker) instead of shadcn Calendar; native <select> filters; delete uses window.confirm instead of AlertDialog (Profile already uses AlertDialog).
'Needs Verification' cards show '100% profile match' which can read as certainty; consider clarifying label.

action_items: Filter guide LLM history by schemeId (GuideService) and fix history ordering (Top40 Desc)
Notification sync: drop superseded 'docs-<scheme>-<n>' notifications and ones for deleted applications
Simulator: don't silently switch a signed-in user's session to a demo persona
Refresh bell unread count after mark-read/mark-all/dismiss (shared context or event)
Make PUT /api/applications partial (only set provided fields) and honor applicationDate/referenceNumber on POST
Fix heading word-spacing (tracking) and Indic letter-spacing; tidy mobile header
critical_code_review_comments: GuideService chat context mixes schemes (see above) — causes confusing AI 'Correction' replies
server.py docstring says Java port 8080 but JAVA_PORT=8095 (cosmetic)
/tmp/entitle-java.log shows NoClassDefFoundError in shutdown hook after jar rebuild while running (benign, from rebuild-in-place)
Demo accounts are shared; any visitor's wizard edits mutate the persona profile permanently (ensurePersonas doesn't reset). Consider resetting persona profile on demo login.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% - all flows functional, 2 UI bugs + design issues

seed_data_creation: No seed scripts run. Test-created applications/saved/checklist items were removed; student & household persona profiles restored to personas.json values via restore_personas.py. Healthcare persona account was deleted (by request) and recreated by re-login. Leftover: some notifications/chat messages on demo users.
